policy.allowed_role: Browser-visible academic search pages may be used as candidate sensors, full-text link sensors, citation-chain sensors, and metadata-export sensors under the unified full-text acquisition and evidence verification workflow.
policy.forbidden_role: They must not become an independent citation verifier, Zotero writer, paywall bypass, captcha bypass, cookie exporter, or high-frequency scraper.

accepted_patterns: single async DOM script per browser operation where feasible
direct navigation to detail pages instead of clicking result links that spawn extra tabs
old-style advanced search page for source category filters
author plus affiliation fields before author-institution downloads
visible Tencent captcha detection by #tcaptcha_transform_dy position
result-table checkbox value as export metadata id
batch export metadata from search results before Zotero planning
journal indexing lookup as a candidate quality signal
rejected_patterns: copying Claude slash-command skills into the local Codex runtime
direct Zotero write before local import plan review
saving browser cookies or login state
using CNKI export metadata as DOI verification
downloading before author-affiliation evidence is present
bypassing login, captcha, paywall, or institutional access restrictions
primary_keys: dbcode/dbname/filename when a detail page exposes them
title plus source plus year for fallback matching
captcha_detection: page title or URL indicates security verification
visible text contains a slider verification instruction

local_smoke_test.environment: Active VELA runtime repository, Playwright MCP browser smoke only, no source-file writes, no full-text download, no Zotero write.
passed_checks: CNKI basic search page loaded after visible security gate cleared in the session.
Basic search selectors input.search-input and input.search-btn returned structured result rows.
Result extraction returned title, href, authors, journal, date, download count, and input.cbItem export ids.
Old-style advanced search URL exposed #txt_1_value1 and source-category checkboxes #SCI, #EI, #hx, #CSSCI, #CSCD, #gjAll.
CSSCI advanced search for 社会资本 returned result count and rows with no automated download.
blocked_checks: Actual PDF or CAJ download was not run in this smoke because it would acquire copyrighted full text.
Zotero push scripts were not used; Zotero writes remain behind ingest-plan and explicit import.
not_tested_checks: User-side slider completion followed by resume in the same run.

result_fields.name: cnki_export_id
result_fields.purpose: batch metadata export from results page

result_fields.name: citation_count
result_fields.purpose: sort and screening signal, not formal quality proof

actions.purpose: Find CNKI candidates by subject, keyword, title, author, affiliation, fulltext, or DOI.
notes: Use envctl cnki-zotero find or fetch instead of standalone slash commands.
Downloaded files must go to the active project outputs/inbox/cnki-downloads when a project root exists.

actions.purpose: Filter Chinese candidates by field, date, source category, author, journal, and author affiliation.
notes: The old-style advanced search URL is required when source category checkboxes are needed.
For author plus institution requests, author-only search is not sufficient.

actions.purpose: Read full candidate metadata, abstract, keywords, fund, classification, DOI, and affiliation text.
notes: Detail-page evidence can satisfy the author-affiliation gate.
DOI found on the page must still be verified by the citation gate before formal writing.

actions.purpose: Trigger PDF or CAJ downloads only in the user's already-authorized browser session.
notes: Do not persist cookies.
Stop on visible captcha, login failure, or missing permission.
Use referrer-preserving browser navigation where direct URL navigation is required.

actions.purpose: Collect CNKI export metadata from the result page without visiting every detail page.
notes: Exported metadata is a Zotero planning input, not final citation verification.
Use local import plans before any Zotero write.

actions.purpose: Check journal inclusion labels and basic evaluation fields for Chinese venue screening.
notes: Journal inclusion is a screening signal and must not replace article-level verification.

accepted_patterns: Google Scholar data-cid as the browser-session primary key
advanced query parameters for author, publication, exact phrase, title-only, and year filters
right-side PDF/HTML link extraction as a full-text candidate sensor
cited-by navigation through the cites parameter for downstream literature discovery
BibTeX retrieval by navigation when CORS blocks direct fetch
low-frequency visible-browser operation rather than high-frequency scraping
rejected_patterns: treating Google Scholar metadata as DOI or publication verification
batch PDF harvesting without OpenAlex/Crossref/Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar first
direct Zotero writes before citation evidence and import planning
primary_keys: exact verified title for per-paper fallback

local_smoke_test.environment: Active VELA runtime repository, Playwright MCP browser smoke only, no source-file writes, no full-text download, no Zotero write.
passed_checks: Google Scholar page navigation reached a visible Scholar page.
The upstream captcha-detection script correctly returned a captcha stop instead of scraping or retrying.
Local policy rejection of Sci-Hub and bypass links was confirmed from upstream gs-fulltext review.
blocked_checks: Live result extraction, data-cid follow-up, and right-side PDF extraction were blocked by the current Google Scholar verification page.
Chrome DevTools MCP list_pages timed out in this session, so upstream's exact chrome-devtools tool path was not considered locally reliable.
not_tested_checks: Cited-by navigation with a live data-cid.
Google Scholar right-side PDF click after a user-cleared verification state.

result_fields.name: authors_source_year
result_fields.purpose: rough metadata for screening, not final citation verification

result_fields.name: data_cid
result_fields.purpose: primary key for citation tracking, versions, and export

actions.purpose: Find broad or filtered Google Scholar candidates after formal/open metadata routes are insufficient.
notes: Keep result pages small to reduce verification challenges.
Google Scholar records can support DOI-waiver evidence only after author, year, title, and source are checked.

actions.purpose: Find and click right-side PDF/HTML links for unresolved English or international full texts.
notes: Use only after batch OpenAlex/Crossref/Unpaywall/Semantic Scholar attempts fail.
Every downloaded file still needs PDF identity validation before it is marked acquired.

actions.purpose: Follow downstream citations using the data-cid cites parameter.
notes: Use for literature discovery and source expansion, not as a quality proof by itself.

actions.purpose: Retrieve BibTeX for candidate metadata review when no better export exists.
notes: Navigate to the BibTeX URL when browser CORS blocks direct fetch.
BibTeX from Google Scholar usually lacks DOI and abstract; it is not final metadata verification.

actions.purpose: Stop automated Scholar activity when verification appears and resume only after user confirmation.
notes: Do not auto-retry loops.
Resume from the failed-item queue rather than restarting the whole batch.
